scope: Six owner-scoped multi-segment V2 Tasks survive a measured full stop of local Temporal, all API/Worker containers and the submitting/observing process; cold replacements reuse the original SQLite store.
excluded_claims: Production Temporal or PostgreSQL availability, failover or storage durability guarantees
Real external model/provider availability, side effects or cost
24-hour execution, throughput, latency or capacity SLO
A measured maximum of two concurrent Activities over the full run
Compose orchestration, native Temporal TLS or Cloud ACL acceptance
passed: two real Tasks reach parent 24 after three CANs with child/summary state; four other owner-scoped Tasks are accepted and remain native SCHEDULED without model execution
all Temporal/API/Worker/observer processes are absent for at least three seconds; fresh processes and connections recover all accepted tasks, complete snapshots and model request identity

all six multi-owner Tasks complete 37 native parent tools, two general-purpose subagents, real summaries and four CANs; 30 native Runs have zero WorkflowTaskFailed, queued tasks drain and original identities/cursors remain valid

image.readme_boundary: Current README and acceptance documentation were edited after this image was built; the historical build README hash is provenance, not a claim that current documentation was rebuilt into the image.

execution_boundary.worker_entrypoint: trusted read-only task_cold_worker_fixture.py calls production load_role_secrets and run_process; image entrypoint override
execution_boundary.model_provider: deterministic simulated model responses; native DeepAgents tools, general-purpose subgraphs and summarization middleware execute
execution_boundary.duration_semantics: Accepted-to-observed-terminal durations include deliberate pacing, gates, queuing, outage and polling; they are not provider latency or throughput.

cold_restart.timeline_clock: Host driver monotonic and UTC wall time; no arithmetic mixes host monotonic with Linux container monotonic timestamps.
cold_restart.observer_connection_boundary: The old observer also submitted Tasks and owned its SDK/HTTP clients. It was SIGKILLed before the zero-service interval. A separate new process creates fresh SDK and HTTP clients after Temporal restarts; the driver owns neither client.

sqlite.hash_boundary: The stopped database hash is an observed pre-restart value; normal resumed execution changes the live database. No copy is substituted for the original directory.

final_state_assertions: All six snapshots retain task_id, workflow_id, owner and first_execution_run_id, schema 2/version task-v2, completed status and no remaining graph nodes.
Exactly one original HumanMessage and parent ToolMessages can-main-000 through can-main-036 in order; no lost or duplicated parent tool steps.
Two real general-purpose subagent return values, child files and all expected parent file contents and metadata are preserved.
The native todo plan is completed; native _summarization_event, _summarization_session_id, summary message and referenced history-offload file remain present.
Each Task has 38 parent model boundaries, four CAN transitions, five native Runs and two summary model Activities in distinct Runs.
Both inflight Tasks have exactly equal complete native snapshots before and after cold restart; no message IDs, timestamps or private fields were normalized.

history_summary.hash_format: SHA-256 of deterministic protobuf History serialization or full input Payloads serialization, computed by the live observer; only hashes and selected queue events are published.

model_attempt_postcheck.source: MODEL_START / MODEL_FINISH records re-read from all four Worker logs and matched exactly against the original receipt

resources.measurement: Owned host process-tree RSS plus live container raw cgroup memory usage; Docker inspect exit/OOM state and VM MemAvailable are also checked.
resources.memory_psi_limitation: OrbStack did not expose PSI in this probe. VM MemAvailable samples are cached during brief intervals with no running owned container; host memory and process/container counts continue to be checked.

cleanup.final_business_container_cleanup: Four replacement API/Worker containers were deliberately SIGKILLed during final cleanup and exited 137 without OOM. This run does not test their graceful drain.

secret_scans.needle_scope: Three synthetic owner tokens, cursor secret and model secret, each raw and JSON-escaped; values omitted.
secret_scans.public_summary_scan: Exact secret needles and host absolute-path prefixes absent.

source_freeze.scope: All 24 production wheel files, four new cold-restart files, directly reused harness/fixture helpers and packaging lock inputs; evolving documentation excluded.

validation.offline_reconciliation: Receipt/manifest/wheel/source/snapshot/result/log file hashes, queue state, all chain links and payload-hash pairs, final native state, replay equality, Activity attempts and resource totals verified.
validation.native_hash_provenance: Original live observer computed History/input hashes. Raw Histories and payloads are not copied into this public summary; those digest values are preserved from the immutable receipt.
validation.module_full_suite: reported separately by the delivery validation owner
